from openpyxl.styles import PatternFill
from pathlib import Path

spreadsheet_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/435-38/1_435-38_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/435-38_0_c2b96e7a/1_435-38_output.xlsx"

wb = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

# Work only within the allowed answer range: A1:B10
start_row, end_row = 1, 10

# Compute the average of numeric values in B1:B10
b_values = []
for r in range(start_row, end_row + 1):
    v = ws.cell(r, 2).value
    if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
        b_values.append(v)

avg_b = sum(b_values) / len(b_values) if b_values else 0

# Find the first row where cumulative sum of A values meets/exceeds avg_b
cum_sum = 0
target_row = None
for r in range(start_row, end_row + 1):
    v = ws.cell(r, 1).value
    if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
        cum_sum += v
        if cum_sum >= avg_b:
            target_row = r
            break

yellow_fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor="FFFF00")
no_fill = PatternFill(fill_type=None)

# Apply highlighting only within A1:A10, preserving all cell values
for r in range(start_row, end_row + 1):
    cell = ws.cell(r, 1)
    if target_row is not None and r <= target_row:
        cell.fill = yellow_fill
    else:
        cell.fill = no_fill

Path(output_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
